rows.actual: Euclidean-DLR existence, compactness, exponential moments, periodic-state accumulation, convex pressure response and the scalar/radial low-temperature phase theorems are established mathematics. The repository-specific contribution is the exact positive-lambda Q3LOCK hypothesis map, its composition with EXP-000780 pressure convergence, the factor-eight tangent-state selection, the locally normal time-zero corollary, and the explicit separation from the lambda0 phase boundary. No new general Gibbs-state or phase-transition theorem and no world-first claim is made.
rows.name: world-first disclaimed

boundary: This package proves existence and compactness of exact fixed-lattice positive-lambda Euclidean equilibrium measures and constructs zero-source DLR tangent states realizing every directional pressure endpoint slope. It does not prove that any slope is strictly positive for lambda>0, that the tangent states are extreme or pure, that they cluster, that a pre-existing infinite-volume real-time dynamics or algebraic KMS state exists, that the ground state is degenerate or gapped, that the lattice can be removed, that a physical empty-space reference or below-empty-space sign is selected, that a 3D-to-1+1 effective map exists, or that C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A or Pre-A is complete.
